text.description_html:
Satin Stainless Steel 10" x 42" Kick Plate

Common size door kick plates primarily used in restaurants, warehouses and stores, but are popular in homes as well. Made of .050" thick high quality stainless steel for longevity. The Kick Plate is 10" wide and 42" long. It is made out of stainless steel with a satin stainless steel finish. Packaged with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.

Also Available: 6" x 34" Stainless Steel Kick Plate, 8" x 34" Stainless Steel Kick Plate and other size Door Kick Plates

Specifications of the DJO-KP-10x42-630 Stainless Steel Kick Plate:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Plate Height: 10"
  • Plate Width: 42"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged with stainless mounting screws.
  • KP1034U32D Dimensions (PDF)

Note: Kick Plates are typically the width of the door less 2 inches. Please measure your door/s for proper fit.

Sold Individually
